chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah who said:

I asked him about buying food that is measured or weighed, is it permissible to buy it without measuring or weighing? He said: If you go to a man regarding food that has already been measured or weighed, and you buy it from him with a profit margin, there is no problem if you buy it and do not measure or weigh it, provided that the first buyer had taken it by measurement or weight. If you say at the time of sale, 'I give you such and such profit in it,' and you are satisfied with your measurement or weighing, then there is no problem.

key_terms.مُرَابَحَةً: With a profit margin / trade on profit

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy food without re-measuring if it was already measured by the seller?
ai.summary: Sama'ah clarifies the fiqh of Murabaha (profit-based resale) in food transactions, establishing that re-measurement is unnecessary if the initial buyer already accepted the weight or volume, thereby validating the sale based on trust in the first transaction's accuracy. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on preventing Gharar (uncertainty) by anchoring the second sale to the established, verified quantity of the first, ensuring commercial fairness and clarity in market dealings.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,

‘I asked him about buying the foodstuff, from what is measure or weighed, is buying it correct without a measurement or weighing?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you go over to a man regarding food which had already been measured or weighed, so you buy it from him with a profit, so there is no problem if you were to buy it and do not measure it or weigh it, when it was such that the former buyer had taken it with a measurement or weight. So you should say when buying, ‘I give you such and such amount of profit, and I am pleased with your measurement or your weighing’, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about buying food which is exchanged by means of weighing or measuring, if such items can be bought without weighing or measuring.

He (the Imam) said, ‘If you find a man with food which he has weighed or measured and it is bought from him with profit for him, it is not harmful if you buy it without weighing and measuring. If the first buyer had bought it by weighing and measurement and you say when buying, “I give you such and such amount of profit and I accept your weighing and measuring then it is not harmful.’””
